test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

We have reorganised the department over the last year.

options.text: The department is being reorganised over the last year.
The department has been reorganised over the last year.
Last year, the department was reorganised.
The department is reorganised by me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "We have reorganised the department over the last year."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the department" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have reorganised" to "has been reorganised" (present perfect passive).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The department has been reorganised over the last year."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The department is being reorganised over the last year." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Last year, the department was reorganised." – Incorrect time phrase usage and past simple tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"The department is reorganised by me." – Incorrect tense and subject.
